ui_student_test_trip_00000052.jpg: Evaluator UI on Laptop 2 connected to the API on Laptop 1 over the phone hotspot (API ONLINE) listing the 10 trips. Trip 00000052 (a student_test trip): top-1 accuracy 96.6% (classifier only) to 99.2% with the HMM, route continuity 92.0% to 96.2%, route arc F1 93.5% to 99.4%, API processing time 0.18 s, model name lightgbm. Orange = classifier-only route, green = classifier + HMM route.
api_log_student_test_lightgbm.jpg: API terminal on Laptop 1: startup loads models/lightgbm.joblib (the untuned LightGBM script's output) and the tuned HMM parameters from results/hmm_lightgbm/best_params.json; /health and /trips return 200; PREDICT lines for student_test trips 00000052 (top1 0.9924, continuity 0.9617, 0.18 s), 00000065 (0.8789, 0.9804, 1.44 s) and 00000091 (0.9405, 0.9725, 1.41 s). These runs used student_test trips as stand-ins for the evaluator trips and the untuned LightGBM, whose decoded accuracy is equal to the Bayesian-tuned model (0.9275 versus 0.9269).
evaluator_trips_results_table.jpg: Per-trip results of the API pipeline on the 10 reserved evaluator trips (every request returned OK, 10/10). Clf = classifier only, HMM = classifier + HMM decoding. Overall (19,674 points): top-1 0.9020 to 0.9510 (+0.0490), route continuity 0.9115 to 0.9657. In the repository's API implementation the Candidate Miss Rate column is the share of points with no candidate arc, which is not the same as the share whose reference arc is missing from the candidate set (0.09% on student_test).
evaluator_trips_benchmark_terminal.jpg: Terminal output of the end-to-end benchmark on the evaluator dataset (10 trips). The benchmark header reports 'Model: LightGBM (tuned) + HMM Viterbi'; the interleaved PREDICT lines are the API's request log (status=200 for every trip).
